description: No pull requests. Everything with automerge below lands as a renovate/* branch that Renovate fast-forwards into main once CI on that branch is green -- which is why .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on renovate/** pushes. Without a status check on the branch Renovate would merge it unverified. Majors keep automerge:false and still open a PR.

The schedule window closes at 05:00 local so an automerged bump still has ~2h of runway before the 05:00 UTC release in .github/workflows/release.yml: the branch has to go green through the full e2e (~35 min) first.

packageRules.description: Third-party images and the RabbitMQ subchart: automerge patches only. A minor bump of Postgres or Typesense is a real upgrade of a stateful component, so it gets a human.
First-party ister images. Each gets its own PR and its own version line — server, player and migrations do not move in lockstep.
GitHub Actions. Grouped, and chore(deps) rather than fix(deps) so a bumped action does not release a new chart — see .github/workflows/release.yml.
Majors are never automerged. They land on the dependency dashboard and wait for a human.
